text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the cutoff time approaching fast,
I was tidying up after our training session, when……

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll wrap things up after one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with only one lap left,
this course covers quite a substantial distance...
choice_data_list: Will we make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No problem. It's what I always do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even waiting for my answer,
she ran off.
In that case...
choice_data_list: Let's tidy things up one step at a time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we cleaned up beside her――
she pulled off a magnificent finish right on time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll pack up the ladder. You can head home now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Surely, she must have her reasons.
Watching her running figure from behind, I left the area.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This is fine………… For her sake,
I have to keep running…… after all……)
